note: Miles and expected in-service dates for Line Watch cards ERCOT's TPIT report does not list yet, each with the source it was read from. Range miles use the low end; miles_text has the range.

cards.miles_text: about 133.2 miles (ERCOT estimate, new right of way)
cards.miles_quote: Construct a new Bell East to Watermill 765-kV single-circuit transmission line ... which will require a new ROW, approximately 133.2-mile.
cards.in_service_quote: The expected in-service date (ISD) of the project is between 2030 and 2032.

cards.miles_text: about 78 miles (ERCOT estimate, new right of way)
cards.miles_quote: Construct a new Dinosaur to Watermill 765-kV single-circuit transmission line ... which will require a new right of way (ROW), approximately 78.0-mile
cards.in_service_quote: The expected in-service date (ISD) of the project is between 2030 and 2032.

cards.miles_text: about 30.9 miles (approved route; filed routes ranged about 28.1 to 36.1 miles)
cards.miles_quote: The route approved in this Order is approximately 30.9 miles in length.
cards.in_service_quote: Oncor estimates it will energize the proposed transmission facilities in December 2028.

cards.miles_quote: The total length of the transmission line is 13.3 miles.
cards.in_service_quote: 2028 ... Winter-Summer | Construction ... Summer | Project in service

cards.miles_text: about 152 to 153 miles (rebuild along existing line; three build options)
cards.miles_quote: The total length of the proposed transmission line is approximately 152 to 153 miles, depending on the route selected.

cards.miles_text: about 2.6 miles (ERCOT review of Oncor's proposal; mostly in existing right of way)
cards.miles_quote: Construct a new Liggett Switch to Skyview Switch 345-kV transmission line ... on the upgraded 2.6-mile portion
cards.in_service_quote: The Project is currently planned for completion in Spring 2027.

cards.miles_quote: The length of the Proposed Transmission Line Project is approximately 73.2 to 85.8 miles, depending on the route selected

cards.miles_text: about 71.9 miles (second circuit on the existing line)
cards.miles_quote: installation of a second 345 kV circuit along the existing 71.9-mile Ranger Camp Switch – Midland East Switch 345 kV transmission line
cards.in_service_quote: West Texas 345-kV Infrastructure Rebuild Project ... with the expected in-service date of summer 2028

cards.miles_text: about 1.78 miles (approved route 1; filed routes 1.63 to 1.78 miles)
cards.miles_quote: The route agreed to by the parties is route 1, which is 1.78 miles in length
cards.in_service_quote: Oncor estimates it will complete construction of facilities and energize the facilities by June 2026.

cards.miles_text: about 15 miles (within existing right of way)
cards.miles_quote: The proposed project will be built entirely within existing Oncor ROW and will be approximately 15 miles long.

cards.miles_text: about 406 miles of new 765 kV lines (Cross Texas's recommended Option 1, not yet an ERCOT estimate)
cards.miles_quote: CTT recommends Option 1 ... 3 new 765 kV stations + ~406 miles of new 765 kV lines
The total length of the proposed transmission line is 28.59 miles to 36.23 miles, depending on the route selected.

cards.miles_text: about 12.1 to 16.1 miles (two new lines; filed routes)
cards.miles_quote: The new transmission lines will be approximately 12.08 to 16.08 miles long depending upon route selected
as well as 22.31 to 30.61 miles of double-circuit 345-kV transmission line connecting the two proposed substations
